pillars.title: We Understand the Project Before the Product
pillars.intro: Every project is assessed together with the building geometry, intended use, fire scenario, airflow, pressure requirements, and site conditions. Where needed, CFD analyses, fan selections, and system scenarios are built on engineering data.

pillars.title: We Manufacture the Designed Solution
pillars.intro: Approved technical data becomes project-specific fans, dampers, silencers, control panels, and auxiliary equipment within the NOVVES production infrastructure. The manufacturing process is managed with quality control, performance expectations, and standard requirements in view.

pillars.title: We Commission Systems That Work on Site
pillars.intro: The process does not end with product delivery. NOVVES focuses on correct on-site operation through installation coordination, commissioning support, control scenarios, technical documentation, and after-sales support.

engineeringShowcase.title: CFD-SUPPORTED ENGINEERING
engineeringShowcase.subtitle: Engineering That Makes Flow Visible
engineeringShowcase.body: Our process does not begin with product selection, but with understanding the building’s aerodynamic behaviour. NOVVES simulates the movement of smoke, heat, and air within the structure using CFD-based analyses; fan placement, flow rate, pressure, and scenario-based operating logic are validated with engineering data.

engineeringPillarsSection.title: From Engineering to the Field
engineeringPillarsSection.subtitle: End-to-End Solutions
engineeringPillarsSection.lead: NOVVES does not treat projects as product supply alone. We analyse the need, design the right system, manufacture it, and make it deployable on site.

faq.desc: The technical details most often asked about NOVVES industrial standards and our CFD analysis processes.
faq.footerLinkAriaLabel: View all frequently asked questions about NOVVES products, engineering services, standards, CFD analyses, after-sales support and project processes.

items.a: NOVVES delivers ventilation, smoke extraction and pressurization solutions in enclosed car parks, tunnels, metro and rail systems, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, shopping malls, hotels, hospitals and other large-scale structures.
items.linkAriaLabel: Explore NOVVES ventilation and smoke extraction solutions for car parks, tunnels, industrial facilities and large-scale buildings.

items.q: Which product groups do you manufacture?
items.a: NOVVES manufactures smoke and heat exhaust fans, axial fans, jet fans, roof fans, wall-mounted fans, centrifugal fans, ex-proof fans, dampers, silencers, control panels and project-specific ventilation equipment.
items.linkAriaLabel: Explore NOVVES product families including smoke exhaust fans, axial fans, jet fans, dampers, silencers and control panels.

items.q: Which standards are your products designed to?
items.a: NOVVES products are designed, tested and documented in line with EN 12101-3, AMCA 210 / ASHRAE 51, ISO 5801 and relevant ventilation, performance and fire-safety standards—depending on product group, application and project requirements.
items.linkLabel: Explore our standards and certification approach →
items.linkAriaLabel: Learn about EN 12101-3, AMCA 210 / ASHRAE 51, ISO 5801 and related performance standards applied to NOVVES products.

items.q: Do you provide CFD-supported engineering services?
items.a: Yes. NOVVES delivers CFD-supported airflow, smoke movement, temperature distribution and fan placement analyses for enclosed car parks, tunnels, industrial facilities and large-scale structures—so systems are evaluated based on building behaviour, not products alone.
items.linkAriaLabel: Explore NOVVES CFD-supported airflow, smoke movement, temperature distribution and fan placement analysis process.

items.q: Do you provide project-specific fan selection and system design?
items.a: Yes. NOVVES evaluates every project together with flow rate, pressure, temperature resistance, usage scenario, site conditions, automation needs and standard requirements. Fan selection, layout, control scenarios and auxiliary equipment are determined on a project-specific basis.
items.linkAriaLabel: Learn about NOVVES project-specific fan selection, flow-pressure assessment, fan layout and system design approach.

items.q: What solutions do you offer for smoke and heat exhaust systems?
items.a: NOVVES provides integrated smoke and heat exhaust solutions with F300/F400-rated smoke exhaust fans, jet fan systems, roof-mounted smoke exhaust fans, wall fans, dampers, silencers and scenario-based control panels.

productCategoryBlurbs: From axial fans to ex-proof systems, roof and duct fans to specialized industrial solutions—our broad product families deliver powerful, efficient air movement.
With air handling units, dehumidification, heat recovery and ex-proof AHU solutions, we deliver efficient climate control for commercial, industrial and special process environments.
With cooling systems, heat pumps, coils, electric heaters and precision-controlled HVAC solutions, we deliver efficient climate control in commercial and industrial spaces.

NOVVES Air Management is our core group; with the Damper Systems product family, we direct, balance, isolate and safely control airflow. For HVAC, ventilation, pressurization and smoke control scenarios, we deliver project-integrated, reliable, engineering-focused solutions.

NOVVES Air Distribution is our core group; with the Grille and Diffuser Systems product family, we distribute conditioned air evenly, quietly and under control. We support indoor comfort, air quality and system efficiency while combining architectural aesthetics with engineering performance.

NOVVES Air Filtration is our core group; with the filter and filtration elements product family, we deliver clean, safe and controlled conditioned air. By reducing particles, dust and contaminants, we support air quality, system efficiency and equipment life in HVAC, ventilation and process systems.

NOVVES Accessories is our core group; with the Fan and HVAC Accessories product family, we deliver engineering solutions that complete ventilation and air-conditioning systems. Connection components, silencers, protection equipment, mounting accessories and system complement products support safe, efficient, project-aligned HVAC infrastructure.

NOVVES Automation, Control and Power Systems is our core group; with automation panels, PLCs, sensors, operator panels, timing devices, power electronics and panel switching product families, we deliver safe, smart and efficient control of HVAC systems.

NOVVES Vibration and Sound Insulation Systems is our core group; with the Vibration Isolators product family, we reduce structure-borne vibration from fans, motors and HVAC equipment. We deliver solutions for quieter, more stable and safer operation—supporting equipment life, occupant comfort and project performance.
